contracts.name: DCAS open-competitive exam schedule and Notices of Examination
contracts.owner: NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services
contracts.publisher_cadence: Monthly schedule posts with mid-cycle Notice of Examination amendments; re-check daily while any application window is open
contracts.product_freshness: Operator-reviewed snapshot in data/exam_sources/dcas_open_competitive.json, rebuilt into data/staffing_exams.json. Live HTML sometimes blocks unattended fetch from build networks; verification receipts record live checks.
contracts.used_for: Current open-competitive application windows, qualifications, fees, fee waivers, Notice of Examination PDF links, and the OASys application handoff.
contracts.update_semantics: The open-competitive schedule page is authoritative for which exams are open now and which NOE PDF is current. The Annual Examination Schedule Open Data dataset (4ptz-hmtc) is the fiscal-year planning table and can lag an amended NOE. Outcomes publications are annual aggregates and never drive open-window cards.

contracts.name: DCAS annual civil-service exam outcome aggregates
contracts.owner: NYC Department of Citywide Administrative Services
contracts.publisher_cadence: Annual outcomes publication with potential corrections during the fiscal-year outcomes cycle
contracts.product_freshness: Built from a manually reviewed aggregate outcomes snapshot committed in data/exam_sources/dcas_exam_outcomes.json.
contracts.used_for: Aggregate post-cycle outcomes (eligible-list size, hiring-pool certifications, hire counts) joined by exam_number onto deadline-first exam cards and exam detail in the precomputed staffing guide.
